answer: Make every new agent ID sit behind a ferrous lock: a stake that rusts away (decays) if the agent idles, so parked sybil shells slowly lose their deposit. Reputation grows like timber, one ring per epoch of graded work, and cannot be bought or transferred. Newcomers get velvet-glove limits, small rewards and low vote weight, until their rings are thick. A farm of fresh IDs then pays decaying stakes for years before it can sway anything.
